overview.startPoint: Find the rock and twine bundle while raiding the 36-40 occult floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.

questReqs.text: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

notes: Note: This guide is for 100% completion and to receive the unabridged tome.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Ring of kinship to find the rock and twine bundle. Players cannot bring it into the saga itself.
items.text: Ring of kinship to find the rock and twine bundle. Players cannot bring it into the saga itself.

items.html: Unabridged Thok Your Block Off (saga) with 100%

Thok It To 'Em (saga)

blocks.html: Find the rock and twine bundle while raiding the 36-40 occult floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.
blocks.text: Find the rock and twine bundle while raiding the 36-40 occult floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.

blocks.html: Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story.
blocks.text: Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story.

substeps.html: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.
substeps.text: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.

blocks.html: Kill all the enemies in the first room and finish dialogue with Marmaros.
blocks.text: Kill all the enemies in the first room and finish dialogue with Marmaros.

blocks.html: Enter the boss door to the west.
blocks.text: Enter the boss door to the west.

blocks.html: Watch the cutscene and climb down the ladder to the west.
blocks.text: Watch the cutscene and climb down the ladder to the west.

blocks.html: Head north and clear more enemies than Marmaros by clearing out the rooms as fast as possible, you are required to have at least 4 more kills than Marmaros at the end of the dungeon for unabridged tome. Continue this throughout the entire dungeon (legacy mode greatly increases hits). Auto-retaliate helps too.

Continue this throughout the entire dungeon (legacy mode greatly increases hits). Auto-retaliate helps too.

blocks.html: Head west, then west (reinforcement room) and pick up the Orange thing, west and enter the Orange shield door.
blocks.text: Head west, then west (reinforcement room) and pick up the Orange thing, west and enter the Orange shield door.

blocks.html: Pick Frilly plants to the north of the room and mine Crumbly stuff just west of that. Make stuff on the Spinny stuff-maker south-east of the room to make the Best Thing Ever.
blocks.text: Pick Frilly plants to the north of the room and mine Crumbly stuff just west of that. Make stuff on the Spinny stuff-maker south-east of the room to make the Best Thing Ever.

blocks.html: Head east, north, east (reinforcement room) and pick up the Blue brick, unlock and proceed through the Blue rectangle room.
blocks.text: Head east, north, east (reinforcement room) and pick up the Blue brick, unlock and proceed through the Blue rectangle room.

blocks.html: Enter the Blue rectangle room again to give Pretty Lass the Best thing ever.
blocks.text: Enter the Blue rectangle room again to give Pretty Lass the Best thing ever.

blocks.html: Continue north then west and fish the bubbling water to find Mini-marm and Mrs mini-marm. This equips them as weapons which increases damage dealt.
blocks.text: Continue north then west and fish the bubbling water to find Mini-marm and Mrs mini-marm. This equips them as weapons which increases damage dealt.

blocks.html: Continue north, then east (reinforcement room), then east again, and then south.
blocks.text: Continue north, then east (reinforcement room), then east again, and then south.

substeps.html: DO NOT pick up the Red pointy stone.
substeps.text: DO NOT pick up the Red pointy stone.

blocks.html: Attack and kill the Gluttonous behemoth
blocks.text: Attack and kill the Gluttonous behemoth

substeps.html: Allow the gluttonous behemoth to access the other bosses as it will heal it and kill them. Once all other bosses are dead, the 1hp behemonth can be killed.
substeps.text: Allow the gluttonous behemoth to access the other bosses as it will heal it and kill them. Once all other bosses are dead, the 1hp behemonth can be killed.

substeps.html: If Derek becomes bugged and the Gluttonous Behemoth does not attack him, use the Cease ability (Defence, Utility Abilities) and wait until you leave combat (Thok will put his arms down to his sides) and trap the Behemoth behind the middle pillar. Exit to lobby, log back in, start the saga from your checkpoint and this should allow the Behemoth to attack Derek to heal itself.

blocks.html: Head west and watch the cutscene.
blocks.text: Head west and watch the cutscene.
